# FDG5035

> AVOID indexers with parameter types other than `System.Int32`, `System.Int64`, `System.String`, `System.Range`, `System.Index`, or an enum, except on dictionary-like types.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.2.1 Indexed Property Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1043
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

CA1043 reports an externally visible indexer with a parameter type other than Int32, Int64, String or Object; in a probe with SDK 10.0.402 it also allowed Int16, Index, Range, enums and type parameters. It does not know dictionary-like types, which the text exempts, so a report on one is not a violation. It allows Object and Int16, which the text does not. CA1043 has no code fix.

## From the book

If the design requires other types of parameters, strongly reevaluate whether the API really represents an accessor to a logical collection. If it does not, use a method. Consider starting the method name with `Get` or `Set`.
